scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w web_app" "npm run dev -w api"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run notices:artifact
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspaces --if-present && npm run notices:check && npm run check:create-studio-package
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build -w web_app && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:android: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:ios: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open ios
